[32998 .NET Application Development | Subject description]
Credit points: 6

This subject introduces you to C# programming using Visual Studio and the .NET development framework. You will explore the .NET framework and its core concepts, applying this knowledge to develop applications in C#.

[32998 .NET Application Development | Learning and teaching activities]
1.5 hour lecture
 1.5 hour lab
 Canvas Discussion board

title: Learning outcomes
content:
[32998 .NET Application Development | Learning outcomes]
SLO1: Understand the .NET framework architecture. (D.1)
SLO2: Understand how the .NET framework implements OO concepts and the implications this has for new language design. (D.1)
SLO3: Understand the mechanisms and techniques for the deployment and configuration of .NET applications. (D.1)
SLO4: Be able to utilize the .NET libraries. (D.1)
SLO5: Design and develop a C# program in the .NET environment. (C.1)
